WITH windowed AS (
  SELECT * FROM audit_logs
  WHERE time BETWEEN '2022-07-20 00:52:30' AND '2022-07-20 00:54:30'
    AND COALESCE(original_table,'') NOT LIKE '%alert%'
), target AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pid, process_guid
  FROM windowed
  WHERE lower(COALESCE(pname,'')) LIKE '%mshta.exe%'
     OR lower(COALESCE(process_name,'')) LIKE '%mshta.exe%'
), target_pid AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pid FROM target WHERE pid IS NOT NULL
), target_guid AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT process_guid FROM target WHERE process_guid IS NOT NULL
), relevant AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN (lower(COALESCE(pname,'')) LIKE '%mshta.exe%' OR lower(COALESCE(process_name,'')) LIKE '%mshta.exe%')
           AND (access IN ('process_create','execute','ACTION_PROCESS_API_CALL') OR raw_event_type LIKE '%procstart%' OR object LIKE '%mshta.exe%') THEN 1
      WHEN lower(COALESCE(childproc_name,'')) LIKE '%mshta.exe%' OR (access='execute' AND lower(COALESCE(object,'')) LIKE '%mshta.exe%') THEN 2
      WHEN pid IN (SELECT pid FROM target_pid) AND (childproc_name IS NOT NULL OR access LIKE '%PROCESS%' OR raw_event_type LIKE '%proc%') THEN 3
      WHEN pid IN (SELECT pid FROM target_pid) AND (filemod_name IS NOT NULL OR regmod_name IS NOT NULL OR netconn_domain IS NOT NULL OR remote_ip IS NOT NULL) THEN 4
      WHEN pid IN (SELECT pid FROM target_pid) AND (access IN ('write','read','file_access','handle_request','connect') OR object IS NOT NULL) THEN 5
      WHEN (ppid IN (SELECT pid FROM target_pid) OR parent_process_guid IN (SELECT process_guid FROM target_guid)) THEN 6
      ELSE 9
    END AS rel_rank
  FROM windowed
  WHERE pid IN (SELECT pid FROM target_pid)
     OR process_guid IN (SELECT process_guid FROM target_guid)
     OR ppid IN (SELECT pid FROM target_pid)
     OR parent_process_guid IN (SELECT process_guid FROM target_guid)
     OR lower(COALESCE(childproc_name,'')) LIKE '%mshta.exe%'
     OR (access='execute' AND lower(COALESCE(object,'')) LIKE '%mshta.exe%')
), dedup AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY rel_rank, access, COALESCE(object,''), COALESCE(childproc_name,''), COALESCE(filemod_name,''), COALESCE(regmod_name,''), COALESCE(netconn_domain,''), COALESCE(remote_ip,''), COALESCE(remote_port,'')
    ORDER BY time, COALESCE(event_record_id, 999999999), COALESCE(source_row_id,'')
  ) AS rn
  FROM relevant
  WHERE rel_rank < 9
)
SELECT
  time, pid, ppid, pname, process_name, access, object, command_line,
  parent_process_name, parent_process_path, parent_command_line,
  process_guid, parent_process_guid, childproc_name, filemod_name, regmod_name,
  netconn_domain, remote_ip, remote_port, source_stream, event_record_id, source_row_id
FROM dedup
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY rel_rank, time, event_record_id, source_row_id
LIMIT 30;
